text:
Kyoto Station has two "Central" exits on opposite sides of the building, and only one of them leads to the city buses. Pick the wrong one with a suitcase and you're in for a long walk 👇

📌 Save the exit card before you arrive 👉 https://japanbystation.com/kyoto-station-which-exit

We matched every gate to the official station map and the city's own transfer guide.

🚌 KARASUMA SIDE (NORTH)

City buses, Kyoto Tower, taxis and the subway. Leave by the Central exit. On weekends the ¥500 EX100 and EX101 express buses to Kiyomizu-dera leave from stop D1.

🚄 HACHIJO SIDE (SOUTH)

The Shinkansen side. Kintetsu to Nara is right in front of the Shinkansen Central exit, and the airport buses leave from the Hachijo exit (Kansai Airport ¥2,800, about 85–90 minutes).

⚠️ The trap: "Shinkansen Central" is not the bus-side Central exit.

🧳 BAGS

JR Central's smart lockers on the Hachijo side start at ¥400 a day, and if you drop the bag by 11:00 they deliver it to your Kyoto hotel around 18:00.

🍜 Hungry? Kyoto Ramen Koji on the 10th floor has ten shops and serves until 21:30.
